subject: Action needed: Novacorp payment failed - card rotation and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Ella Simmons <ella@novacorp.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment failed on invoice INV-9231 — what we can provide

Hi Markus,

We just received a decline notice for INV-9231 (USD 18,400) from our payment processor. The card on file shows a 'processor_declined' response. Finance is asking for anything that helps avoid chargeback or to retry — specifically:

- Full gateway decline code and timestamps (UTC)
- Any matching AVS/CCV hints we can pass to our bank
- A copy of the attempted authorization trace and settlement window

Can you share the minimal evidence that satisfies our acquirer? Our renewal window is next Tuesday and we want to avoid a service disruption for 2027-07-06.

Thanks,
Ella Simmons
Billing Operations
Novacorp

Attachment: none
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ella Simmons <ella@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment failed on invoice INV-9231 — what we can provide

Hi Ella — looping in Monica (collections lead) and Rishi (payments ops). We can provide the gateway decline trace and a short timeline; I included a CSV extract of the authorization attempts and a PDF with the token/txn details for the acquirer.

Quick plan:
1) Monica will review whether we can attempt an auto-rotation to the secondary card on file (Novacorp indicated a backup card in their vault).
2) If rotation is not possible or fails, Rishi will prepare the processor decline packet (CSV + trace) you can hand to your acquirer.
3) If Novacorp prefers to update card themselves, we can send a secure card-update link that preserves the invoice association — avoids creating a new invoice.

Can you confirm whether Novacorp is comfortable trying rotation first, or do you want the secure link? If you want rotation, we need authorization from your billing address owner (billing@novacorp.com) to proceed.

Markus
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: novacorp_payment_trace.csv; chargeback-evidence.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ella Simmons <ella@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment failed on invoice INV-9231 — what we can provide

Thanks Markus. Ella — I pulled the traces and ran a quick risk check. Notes:

- Decline code: 302 (soft_decline - insufficient_funds / processor policy) at 2027-06-27T23:09:41Z and retry at 2027-06-28T02:13:09Z (both failed).
- AVS matched on street number but zip mismatch on the second attempt (likely bank-level rule).
- No pre-existing chargeback flags on the tokenized payment method.

Action options:
- We can attempt an immediate rotation to the backup token vault entry (token_2) — 1-hour window to confirm before final settlement. This usually succeeds ~62% when the bank permits off-session rotation.
- If you prefer, we can issue a secure card-update link that ties back to INV-9231 and keeps the same billing metadata (recommended if the end-customer can update details).

Please reply with either: 
A) AUTHORIZE_ROTATION (we will proceed and notify you within 60 minutes)
B) SEND_UPDATE_LINK (we will send the secure link to billing@novacorp.com)

If we don't hear back by EOD Friday (2027-07-02 20:00 PT) we will schedule an auto-retry per our dunning cadence (1 more attempt before service hold).

-Monica
Senior Collections Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: novacorp_payment_trace.csv
From: Ella Simmons <ella@novacorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 3 Jul 2027 16:42:00 -0700

Hi Monica — AUTHORIZE_ROTATION. Please proceed with the backup token immediately.

Also, can you send the processor packet to billing@novacorp.com after the attempt either way — acquirer may still request the decline trace for reconciliation. If rotation fails, we'll fall back to the secure link and our AP team will update the card (they prefer to do it themselves).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Ella
Billing Operations
Novacorp
